newsitem.title: USA: Minerals Technologies sees upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Minerals Technologies sees upward trend.

text.p: Minerals Technologies Inc said Thursday that worldwide sales of its refractory products were down in the third quarter, but profitability remained higher than during the same period the prior year.
Those products are used primarily in the steel industry. Sales decreased 6 percent to $46.5 million from $49.6 million in the third quarter of 1995.
The company said its overall results have "shown steady improvement" throughout 1996.
"We expect that trend to continue," Minerals Chairman and Chief Executive Jean-Paul Valles said in a statement.
